candidates.why: The patient presented with a large ovarian mass and diffuse peritoneal implants, which are characteristic of ovarian cancer.

candidates.name: Krukenberg tumor

candidates.why: The presence of peritoneal implants and a large ovarian mass suggests the possibility of a Krukenberg tumor.

candidates.name: Serous ovarian carcinoma

candidates.name: Mucinous ovarian carcinoma

candidates.name: High-grade serous ovarian carcinoma
support_spans: poorly differentiated carcinoma on frozen section analysis
candidates.why: The diagnosis of poorly differentiated carcinoma on frozen section analysis is consistent with high-grade serous ovarian carcinoma.

candidates.name: Ovarian clear cell carcinoma

candidates.why: The presence of gray-white solid areas with hemorrhage and necrosis on gross examination suggests the possibility of ovarian clear cell carcinoma.
